record.title: microduck-face-part
record.why: MEASURED 2026-09-02 (lane T): the shelf's own check FAILed this folder for declaring ZERO interfaces, and that is now settled — cad/interfaces.json declares four MEASURED anchors — 'eye_ring_seat' (front face plane y -55.5000 with a Ø14.5000 x 1.3000 aperture on the optical axis), 'camera_mount' (4 x Ø1.6000 x 4.2500 M2 tap pilots on Ø4.5000 x 6.7000 bosses, a 13.5000 x 21.0000 mm rectangle), 'shell_screws' (4 x Ø2.0500 x 4.0000 with Ø2.7000 x 1.0000 counterbores on Ø6.0000 x 10.7000 bosses, 57.8400 x 22.8700 mm) and 'front_pair' — all read off Pollen's face_part.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders at 0.0000 mm fit residual and 355.0 deg cover, frozen in out/laneT/features/face_part.json. WHAT IS STILL MISSING, named rather than left as 'nothing measured yet': cad/part.py is still the `bin/triad new part` SKELETON and builds no geometry. And one measured feature has no explanation: 'front_pair', 2 x Ø2.0500 x 4.0000 at (32.4000, -53.2000, 20.0000) and (12.6000, -53.2000, 20.0000) — the only asymmetric pattern on the part, matched by no mesh in any of Pollen's four MJCF files and named in no document here. What settles both: a loader or graded rebuild for the geometry, and a photograph of the face plate's front with the bezel off for the pair. 2026-09-03 (lane A, tools/head_frontfit.py): the ToF WINDOW in this part is now MEASURED rather than absent — out/head/front_view.json's 'the mesh has no ToF window geom' was true of the geom list and false of the geometry. Read as the hole in this part's segmentation mask that does not contain the eye ring (the compute board renders through it), in a level front view at 8.6309 px/mm: aperture 10.658 × 6.053 mm ± 0.126 (one mask pixel), centre 22.387 ± 0.402 mm to the head's right of the eye-ring axis and 2.219 mm below it; the MJCF's 'tof' site sits 0.113 mm outboard of that centre. Against the product photograph the window's width, height and lateral offset all agree inside the 1.5 mm rule (−0.505 / −0.426 / +0.479 mm); its VERTICAL offset does not (photograph level with the eye, mesh 2.219 mm below — −2.018 mm, CANNOT DETERMINE, the photograph's blob being a dark-threshold read rather than the aperture edge).
record.origin_why: the geometry this folder describes is Pollen Robotics' own published sim asset (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/), measured but not designed here; CC BY-SA-NC 4.0 per the pollen-robotics/microduck_rl README, so usable to assemble, render, simulate and print, NOT licensed for sale.
